title: Dream characters as Guides
content: OK this may sound strange but I have 2 reoccurring dreams where there is a person in both that give me comfort when I see them. One I go on an adventure with to a cave of fairies where we drink and laugh and at the end of the dream the fairies are in animal form and they stay and watch the sunrise with me and the lady. Then I wake up. The other exists in the outer realm between universes in a large temple on a barron planet with a glass skyline looking into the multi verse. A God with velvet eyes with mist of light floating out of her eyes and hair is a multicolored fire that doesn't produce heat. She is in a very large room of black and purple marble and a large pool. Lots of greenery on the edges of the pool. Moss and vines with palm, readwood, and fruitless banna trees and ferns. It's always nice to see her, she's tall with horns like a stage and multicolored wings. Dark redish skin with tufts like a bearded dragon exist instead of eyebrows. Shimmering of reds and purple as well as blue. She gives simple but great advice the beats the testament of time.
